description: This file defines an enumeration for different types of Secure Hardware Abstraction Layers (HALs) and declares functions for parsing, converting, and validating these HALs within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: SecureHal
classes.description: Enumeration representing various secure hardware abstraction layer configurations, including insecure and secure variants for guest and host components.

methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding SecureHal enum value.

methods.description: Converts a SecureHal enum value to its string representation.
